name: runtime-execution
description: Policy-neutral child-process execution primitives used by Revisor adapters, including captured output, timeout termination, Windows shim handling, and per-call environment forwarding.
cardTemplate: Summarise the runtime-execution domain: policy-neutral child-process invocation, timeout ownership, captured output, and environment forwarding.
rationale: Security-scan policy owns the meaning and lifecycle of CODEX_SECURITY_STATE_DIR. The generic process runner only forwards an optional environment and owns the spawned process lifecycle, so it remains reusable by CI and other adapters without importing review-gate policy.
